249575101_415f9595.text: Unlike the majority of the dorsal thalamus in mice, the retino-recipient dorsal lateral geniculate nucleus (dLGN) contains a subset of inhibitory (GABAergic) interneurons that spatially and temporally synchronize local networks (15)(Halassa et al., 2019)(Sherman, 2004)

249575101_3578d276.text: .These long-range inhibitory connections differentiate the PHb from the dLGN, which only contains local inhibitory networks (Morgan et al., 2019).
